```{r}


first_stage_test_bis_nuclear <- first_stage_data %>%
  mutate(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >200),
    pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >200),
    unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >200)
    ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_creneau_unavailability = sum(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_creneau_unavailability = sum(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_day_unavailability = sum(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_day_unavailability = sum(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)

```


```{r}

#il faut regarder si l'on est un seuil
# à savoir si le même creneau  de l'auction suivante 
# a une indisponibilité différente


price_data_nuclear <- first_stage_test_bis_nuclear %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, nuclear_unavailability_creneau, nuclear_unavailability_creneau - lag(nuclear_unavailability_creneau))),
         
         pub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau - lag(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau))),
         unpub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau - lag(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau)))
         
         ) %>%
  ungroup()



price_data_nuclear %>% 
  filter(unavailability_trigger != 0, Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity != 0) %>%
  group_by(pub_unavailability_trigger, unpub_unavailability_trigger) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), 
            mean_price_diff = mean(price_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean_unavailability_size = mean(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE))


```


```{r}

price_data_nuclear_pub <- price_data_nuclear %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(
    auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before),
    reference_auction = if (any(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(auction_before[pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)
    },
    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>% 
group_by(electricity_delivery_date, 
           pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau
           ) %>% 
  
    mutate(
    unavail_pub_level = ifelse(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau== 0,
         0, mean(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[pub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

    unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
    )%>% 
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4
 
  ungroup() 


price_data_nuclear_unpub <- price_data_nuclear %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%

    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)
    },
    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction
  ) %>%

group_by(electricity_delivery_date, 
           unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau
           ) %>% 
  
    mutate(
    unavail_unpub_level = ifelse(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau== 0,

    unavail_unpub = unavail_unpub_level* unpub_unavailability_trigger,

  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4

  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
```

```{r}

price_data_nuclear_wide_pub <- price_data_nuclear_pub %>% 
            distinct(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, 
           unavail_pub, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  # Agréger les valeurs si plusieurs existent par (date, creneau, distance)
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, 
           unavail_pub) %>%
   select(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, unavail_pub, price_diff,
           gen_tot,unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables,
          reference_auction, Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity) %>%
  # Transformer en format large par distance_auction
  pivot_wider(names_from = distance_auction, 
              names_prefix = "price_", 
              values_from = price_diff)


# Extraire toutes les colonnes "price_*"
price_cols <- grep("^price_", colnames(price_data_nuclear_wide_pub), value = TRUE)

# Extraire la partie numérique et filtrer entre -3 et 3
price_cols_filtered <- price_cols[as.numeric(sub("price_", "", price_cols)) %in% -2:2]

# Trier les colonnes sélectionnées
price_cols_sorted <- mixedsort(price_cols_filtered)

# Récupérer les autres colonnes
non_price_cols <- setdiff(colnames(price_data_nuclear_wide_pub), price_cols)

# Réorganiser le dataframe
price_data_nuclear_wide_pub <- price_data_nuclear_wide_pub[, c(non_price_cols, price_cols_sorted)]
```

```{r}

evaluate_price_coeff <- function(data, var){
  table_coefficients_nuclear <- data.frame()
  col = "price_0"
  for (col in price_cols_sorted){
    # Créer la formule pour la régression
    
    # Créer la formule en utilisant backticks pour le nom de colonne
    formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ ", var ," + gen_tot +
                                intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction)+ as.factor(creneau)" , sep = ""))
    
    # Ajuster le modèle
    model <- lm(formula, data = data 
                #%>% filter(!is.na(price_1) & ! is.na(`price_-1`))
  )
    
    vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
    # Erreurs standard clusterisées
    cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
    
    
    coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
    n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
    # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
    temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
                          estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                          std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                          t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                          p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de la valeur p
      # temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
      #                     estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
      #                     std_error = coefficients[2, 2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
      #                     t_value = coefficients[2, 3], # Recalcul de la valeur t
      #                     p_value = coefficients[2, 4])  # Recalcul de la valeur p
      # 
      # 
    # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
    table_coefficients_nuclear <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear, temp_df)
  }
return(table_coefficients_nuclear)
}

table_coefficients_nuclear_pub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_nuclear_grouped_pub, "unavail_pub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Published")

table_coefficients_nuclear_unpub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_nuclear_grouped_unpub, "unavail_unpub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Unpublished")

table_coefficients_nuclear_tot <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_nuclear_grouped_tot, "unavail") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Total")



```





```{r}

table_coefficients_nuclear <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear_pub, table_coefficients_nuclear_unpub, table_coefficients_nuclear_tot)

table_coefficients_nuclear<- table_coefficients_nuclear %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)))


# Ajouter un léger décalage sur l'axe X en fonction de 'status'
ggplot(data = table_coefficients_nuclear, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
           y = estimate, 
           color = status)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage horizontal
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - qnorm(0.95) * std_error,
                    ymax = estimate + qnorm(0.95) * std_error), 
                width = 0.2, 
                alpha = 0.5, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage identique pour barres d'erreur
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to plant availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh Immobilisé")


```
